name: Quora Business Profile

sources.title: Batch-provided business-create URL — returned 403 to automated fetch; not verifiable
Quora for Business — advertising portal (Quora Ads), not a free listing route

conditions: The free path is a regular Quora user account with a filled-out profile (bio, credentials, website link) plus genuine Q&A participation
The dedicated 'business profile' creation page could not be verified — it returned 403; it may require login, a specific region, or no longer exist
requirements: A Quora user account (email or Google/Facebook login) is required for any presence
Quora enforces real-name policy on profiles — brand impersonation accounts can be flagged
business.quora.com is the paid Quora Ads portal — do not confuse ad account creation with an organic listing
preparation: Email for the Quora account (use a person/founder name, not just a brand name)
Profile bio, credentials line ('Founder at X'), and the product URL for the profile
5-10 relevant questions/topics where the product is a genuinely useful answer
workflow: Create a Quora account at quora.com (signup is gated behind login wall)
Complete the profile: photo, credentials, bio containing the product and its URL
Attempt https://www.quora.com/business/create while logged in to check whether a business-profile flow exists for the account
Answer relevant questions substantively; link to the product only where it is directly responsive
watchFor: quora.com/business/create 403'd to automated fetch — verify manually logged-in before relying on it
Quora aggressively collapses promotional answers and link-drops; accounts can be edit-banned
Quora links are nofollow — value is referral traffic and entity presence, not link equity
Do not run paid Quora Ads expecting an organic listing — the two are unrelated
countsAsLive: The public Quora profile page (quora.com/profile/<name>) renders for a logged-out viewer with bio and credentials; any business-profile page, if the flow exists, is publicly reachable
unknowns: Whether a dedicated free 'business profile' creation flow still exists (page 403'd)
Whether profile website links are exposed to logged-out viewers
